title: Zesty Citrusy French Pork Shoulder Terrine
description: A classic Lyonnaise dish featuring pork shoulder and double-rise bread, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a zesty citrus twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
In a large Dutch oven, sear the pork shoulder over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the garlic, orange marmalade, and lemon zest to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven, cooking for 6 hours or until the pork is tender.
While the pork is cooking, slice the double-rise bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
Once the pork is done, remove it from the pot and shred it into bite-sized pieces.
Strain the cooking liquid and discard the solids, then stir in the butter until melted.
To assemble the terrine, layer the toasted bread, shredded pork, and cooking liquid in a large bowl or terrine mold.
Refrigerate the terrine for at least 2 hours before serving.
